summary: Phase 3(b) Special Needs v3 backend + frontend testing complete. Backend unit tests (12) and new API integration tests (7) all pass. Frontend: schema loads (10 principles / 60 questions), Likert selectors work, progress label updates, Next disabled until section complete then enables, autosave to /answers/bulk fires with 200, reload persists prior answers via GET /me, all 10 principles navigable, Finish button shows only on P10 and posts to /complete, results view renders overall/strongest/priority/per-principle chips (toolkit correctly hidden when P3 rating is Good), Restart calls DELETE /me and returns to empty P1. Dashboard card 'dashboard-special-needs-v3-card' present and navigates correctly. Legacy /neurodivergent still loads and renders.
critical_code_review_comments: Orientation gating: fresh users are redirected to /orientation on every login until localStorage flag 'sacoparents.orientation_seen.v1' is set. The 'orientation-skip-button' click sets localStorage but did NOT immediately redirect to /dashboard in testing — required manual navigation. Not a Phase 3(b) blocker, but the Skip button UX appears to only update state without navigating. Consider having Skip also navigate to /dashboard.
SpecialNeedsV3.jsx line 198: `useNavigate();` is called but its return value is discarded. Dead code — remove.

sn_v3_routes.py: `_get_or_create_doc` is called inside /answer and /answers/bulk but not awaited-wrapped in a transaction; concurrent requests could race and drop answers. Low risk for single-user session but worth noting.

Answer collection uses find by (user_id, completed: {$ne: True}) but /me uses sort updated_at desc which could return an already-completed doc if a stale in-progress doc exists — mostly harmless because /complete only affects the in-progress doc.
seed_data_creation: sn_v3_assessments docs created and cleaned up per test via DELETE /special-needs-v3/me
context_for_next_testing_agent: To bypass the orientation redirect in Playwright, set localStorage key 'sacoparents.orientation_seen.v1' = 'true' before login. Dashboard card lives at bottom of dashboard; scroll to it. All SNv3 selectors are prefixed 'snv3-' as documented in the review request. Backend API tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_sn_v3_api.py.
